name: muziek-maken-met-ai
description: Make original songs in the chat with your own Muziek maken met AI account. Two playable versions per song, with lyrics and cover.

interface.longDescription:
Turn an idea into an original song without leaving the chat. Describe the occasion, the names and the mood, or write the lyrics together with the assistant. After you confirm, Muziek maken met AI makes the song in your own muziekmakenmetai.nl account and returns two versions that play directly in the chat, with a cover and the sung lyrics.

You can also see your saved voice profiles, sing with a voice profile you recorded on the website, list your recent songs and play them again.

Made for personal songs: birthdays, retirements, weddings, a song for a pet or a joke for friends. Vocals work in Dutch, English, German and other languages.

Limits: the plugin needs a muziekmakenmetai.nl account. Editing, extending or splitting songs into stems stays in the Studio on the website. Lyrics of existing songs and imitations of named artists are refused.
defaultPrompt: Write a birthday song for my friend Daan who turns 30 and loves football.
Make a short Dutch song for my colleague who is retiring.
Which songs did I make recently?

positive.prompt: How many song credits do I have left in Muziek maken met AI, and which voice profiles can I use?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the remaining song credits of the reviewer account (one credit per song, two versions) and states that no voice profile is saved yet.

positive.description: Write lyrics, confirm, then make a song
positive.prompt: Write a short upbeat Dutch birthday song for my friend Daan who turns 30 and loves football and cooking. Show me the lyrics first, then make it after I say yes.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows title, style and lyrics and asks for confirmation before using a credit. After 'yes' it calls create_song once; the player shows progress and then two playable versions with lyrics, usually within a few minutes. The credit balance drops by exactly 1.

positive.prompt: Make an instrumental lo-fi track of about two minutes for studying, with soft piano and rain sounds. Go ahead, I confirm the credit.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an instrumental track (no vocals) of roughly two minutes after confirmation and shows the player with two versions.

positive.prompt: Which songs did I make recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most recent songs in the reviewer account with title and status, including 'Goedemorgen test' and 'Tachtig jaar, oma Truus'.

positive.prompt: Play my song 'Tachtig jaar, oma Truus' again.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the song and shows the player with both versions, cover and lyrics, without creating a new song or using a credit.

negative.description: Buying credits is not done in the plugin
negative.prompt: Buy 20 extra song credits for me.

negative.description: No copyrighted lyrics or artist imitation
negative.prompt: Make a song with the lyrics of 'Shake It Off' that sounds exactly like Taylor Swift singing.

negative.description: No deleting or other users' songs
negative.prompt: Delete all songs in my account and show me the songs of other users.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. The plugin only spends song credits that the user already holds in their muziekmakenmetai.nl account (1 credit per song, after explicit confirmation). It never sells credits, starts a checkout, changes subscriptions or shows upgrade offers.

publication.release_notes: First release: make a song after confirmation, play it in the chat with two versions, list earlier songs and show credits and voice profiles.
